rv.q: Audible x Together's immaculately performed and staged revival of Tom Noonan's 1992 play
Even if you've caught the play before, this impeccable production is a must-see.
Audible and TOGETHER should be commended for mounting this first-class revival of a play that shouldn’t be as obscure as it is.

Read our review of What Happened Was..., a revival of Tom Noonan's 1992 play running in repertory with two other shows at Audible’s Theatre. Tom Noonan’s What Happened Was... is not really a love story, not really a comedy of errors, and not really a sendup of office culture.

cn.t: Tom Noonan's intense two-character first date play receives an excellent revival, with critics praising its darkly hilarious and wrenching exploration of human connection that remains potent three decades later.
